name: video_speed
description: Change the playback speed of a video or audio file (0.25× to 8×), for example 2 for a quick time-lapse or 0.5 for slow motion, and/or play it backwards. Voices keep their natural pitch unless keep_pitch is false (chipmunk/deep effect). Reverse is limited to 10-minute files.

input.description: Path of the video or audio file, relative to the workspace.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier from 0.25 to 8 (2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed). Default 1.

keep_pitch.description: Keep voices at natural pitch when changing speed. Default true.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_<speed>x.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
